arg.name: description_package
arg.description: Description package with robot URDF/xacro files. Usually not set, it enables use of a custom description.

arg.name: description_file
arg.description: URDF/XACRO description file with the robot.

arg.name: use_mock_hardware
arg.description: Whether to use mock hardware or real hardware.

arg.name: robot_1_prefix
arg.description: Prefix of the joint names, useful for multi-robot setup. If changed, joint names in controller config must also be updated.

arg.name: robot_1_model
arg.description: The Kassow robot model to use.

arg.name: robot_2_prefix
arg.description: Prefix of the joint names, useful for multi-robot setup. If changed, joint names in controller config must also be updated.

arg.name: robot_2_model
arg.description: The Kassow robot model to use.

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share $(var description_package))/urdf/$(var description_file).urdf.xacro \ use_mock_hardware:=$(var use_mock_hardware) \ robot_1_model:=$(var robot_1_model) \ robot_1_prefix:=$(var robot_1_prefix) \ robot_1_ip:=$(var robot_1_ip_address) \ robot_1_port:=$(var robot_1_port) \ robot_1_session_id:=$(var robot_1_session_id) \ robot_2_model:=$(var robot_2_model) \ robot_2_prefix:=$(var robot_2_prefix) \ robot_2_ip:=$(var robot_2_ip_address) \ robot_2_port:=$(var robot_2_port) \ robot_2_session_id:=$(var robot_2_session_id)')
